author: Visualdef
quote: I did not enjoy the first 20 hours. It was very slow and much of the mundane tasks pointless. The freedom like the previous GTA is not there. It has picked up a little, but still not fun. I’m not sure I am going to complete the current chapter. Very disappointed. Research if its your type of game before you buy. Last time I’m listening to hype.

author: Visualdef
quote: Amazing story, as old as time. Gorgeous graphics. Addicting fun. Was a blast!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
